At ~10k lines of code, it’s 95% smaller than Nextjs with a similar DX. Its minimal surface area and no-build architecture let AI agents read the framework source directly from node_modules, allowing them to understand and build without needing an MCP.

records.name: YTubeStats AI
records.tagline: Analyze YouTube comments & channels with AI in seconds
records.description: YTubeStats AI helps YouTube creators and marketing agencies understand their audience instantly. 🎯 What it does: - Analyzes 100 comments in seconds with Dracula-AI - Deep channel analysis (last 50 videos) - Shorts vs. long-form performance breakdown - AI-powered content strategy suggestions 💡 Who it's for: - YouTube content creators - Social media agencies - Brand managers ⚡ Free to try ( no credit card required )

records.name: Schedly
records.tagline: AI Social Media Management Platform
records.description: Schedly is an AI social media scheduling platform that helps you automate post creation, timing, and publishing across multiple platforms. Boost engagement, save time, and streamline your social media marketing.

records.name: PropPulse, Faster replies. More viewings
records.tagline: qualify tenants and buyers before agents get involved
records.description: Most missed opportunities aren't about lead volume. They disappear after the enquiry lands — in slow replies, inconsistent handling, and prospects who never get offered a slot.

records.name: DedupFuzzy AI
records.tagline: AI fuzzy matching & deduplication — no code
records.description: DedupFuzzy is an online fuzzy duplicate detection tool for spreadsheets and lists. Use AI-assisted matching to find near-duplicates, merge records, and clean company and contact data.

records.name: QuickConvert File Conversion in Chrome
records.tagline: Convert Save in any format!
records.description: Convert 100+ file formats instantly right in your browser. No uploads, no servers, 100% private. Free Chrome extension.
